claim: The river archive supports descriptive comparisons, but lake coverage is incomplete and the flow distribution is skewed.
checks: UTC grid; unique sorted keys; counts reconcile; nine parameter series
method: monthly grid coverage and station quantiles
uncertainty: exact frozen-archive counts; not statistical uptime; dependent timestamps
limitation: inferred grid denominator; no extrapolation beyond the selected archive

claim: Historic river discharge co-varies across several tested lags; no specific transit time is validated.
checks: exact source time t-lag; same endpoint support within each upstream station
method: Pearson correlation at six illustrative offsets; fixed UTC block resampling
uncertainty: 95% seven-day-block intervals (avoids overconfident naive SE from repeated 5-min rows); cross-week dependence still possible; not adjusted across lags
sensitivity: P-S1 qualifies source approval, not a lag test
limitation: shared season or weather; no persistence benchmark or event timing validation; supports vary across stations

claim: Requiring final approval on all nine inputs eliminates the joint sample.
checks: final set nested in historical sample; blockers identified; no fill or invented estimate
uncertainty: 95,053 to zero; joint effect and interval not estimable
limitation: provisional approval is not a finding of measurement failure

claim: Requiring lake observations primarily limits historical coverage; same-date endpoint flow means differ little.
checks: joint lake-complete set nested; both shared-date cohorts cover same UTC dates; no imputation
method: report full-window availability separately; paired seven-day-block resampling of same-date difference
limitation: same date is not same time; missingness and shared conditions can select episodes; no causal lake effect

claim: The evidence does not establish true channel depth or permit operational forecast/response.
fields: station-relative level; reported GIS and CV provenance; ECCC 2026-11-17 assumed-datum reply
checks: recorded datum separation; target locations are unobserved; data-screen eligibility is not manual validation
uncertainty: unverified vertical transfer (ECCC confirmed most stations use assumed datum) and no independent event/target validation
sensitivity: geometry comparison not estimable without datum
limitation: no validated hydraulic status or operational V4 inference
